title: Demo Flow Config
description: Per-flow configuration for the /video narrated product-demo pipeline. The capture -> VO -> assemble -> review engine is flow-agnostic; this config carries the flow-specific beat list, seed identity, app target, narration, and delivery destinations so a new flow can be produced without editing the SKILL or the tooling. schemaVersion pins the structural contract.

schemaVersion.description: Structural version of this config contract. Bump only on a breaking shape change.

flowId.description: Stable machine identifier for the flow (kebab/lowercase). Used for filenames, build-state keys, scope tags.

title.description: Human-facing title of the demo video (used in delivery rows and the article).

targetRuntimeSec.description: Inclusive [min, max] target runtime window in seconds for the assembled MP4. The orchestrator gates final duration against this window.

narration.description: Voiceover (ElevenLabs) settings shared across all beats.

voiceName.description: Human-readable ElevenLabs voice name to render the narration with.

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice id. Null means resolve by voiceName at runtime (call the voices API and bind the id once).

style.description: Narration style directive (e.g. value-first / JTBD, plain-English, spoken full names not acronyms).

splash.description: Loading-splash guard config. The app shows a branded loading splash on boot and on some in-app navigations; capture must wait it out and assembly must trim any frames that slip through.

anchorSelector.description: A known post-splash element selector to poll for before starting any value action (real screen anchor, not the splash).

loadingText.description: The literal loading-splash copy to detect/forbid in final frames.

maxTrimSec.description: Cap on how much leading static/dark footage the splash auto-trim may remove, so a mis-detect can't eat real content.

app.description: Target running-app config the capture agents drive.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the running app to drive (portal/instructor surface).

auth.description: How capture establishes and maintains an authenticated session.

strategy.description: Auth bootstrap strategy. storageState reuses a saved session across beats; supabase-password logs in fresh; enrollment-blob hydrates a learner PWA via localStorage; none for unauthenticated surfaces.
How an expired token is refreshed (Supabase refresh_token grant written back to storageState, full re-login, or none).

viewports.description: Capture viewport sizes per surface family, as [width, height] pixel pairs.

tablet.description: Tablet/mobile portrait capture viewport [w, h] (assembler pillarboxes onto the 1920x1080 canvas).

seed.description: Demo-data seeding contract. Identity must be deterministic across pre/post-state beats and PII-safe.

strategy.description: How demo state is established/mutated. script seeds fresh; targeted-update mutates in place (preferred mid-flow to avoid re-minting captured identities); none if the env is pre-seeded.

scopeTag.description: Scope/tag applied to seeded rows so they can be isolated and cleaned up.

fixedEnrollmentCode.description: FIXED enrollment code so the same learner reads identically across beats. Human-friendly alphabet (no 0/O/1/I/L/5/S).

piiSafe.description: Whether seeded data is guaranteed anonymized / PII-safe (no real learner names on camera).

demoOrgAllowlist.description: Org names that demo seeding/capture is permitted to touch.

beats.description: Ordered beat list. Each beat is one capture unit (one webm). Order is the cut order.

id.description: Stable beat identifier (used for filenames scripts/demo/beats/NN-<id>.mjs and dependsOn references).

surface.description: Which capture surface this beat records (portal desktop vs tablet portrait).

voGist.description: The narration gist for this beat (value-first). Final VO copy is reconciled against captured pixels before TTS render.

waitFor.description: Post-splash / post-load anchor selector this beat must poll for before starting the value action.

dependsOn.description: Ids of beats that must be captured (or state-mutated) before this beat. Encodes lifecycle ordering (e.g. a post-review beat depends on the review action). Empty for independent beats.

deliver.description: Where the finished video is delivered.

slack.description: Slack delivery target (brokered via the Mothy MCP).

channel.description: Slack channel id to post the video to.

dm.description: Whether to also DM the requester.

sheet.description: Google Sheet log target (brokered via the Mothy MCP).

tab.description: Tab/sheet name to append the row to.

columns.description: Ordered column headers the delivery row is written against.

privacy.description: Vimeo privacy settings for the uploaded video.

view.description: Who can view the video on Vimeo.

article.description: Knowledge-base article (/article) destination derived from this flow.

dc.description: Zoho data center / domain (e.g. com, eu, in) used to build the API base URL.

rootCategory.description: Existing root KB category to publish under (cannot create a root category; reuse this and create only sections).

status.description: Publish status. Always Draft for automated runs.
